observation.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && T=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$T" --data-urlencode "user[login]=verified@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678"; curl -s -b cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "proposal76 show=%{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:3000/proposals/76"; curl -s -b cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "proposal76 slug=%{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:3000/proposals/76-mitmach-validierungstest-2026"
